jobs.title: Real Estate Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**WHY JOIN ALO?**

Mindful movement. It's at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it's our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That's the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

**OVERVIEW**

The Real Estate Project Coordinator plays a critical role in the Global expansion and store development lifecycle. This individual manages the administrative, due diligence, and internal cross-functional approval workflows. They act as the central hub between internal stakeholders (Real Estate, Legal, Construction, Finance, Store Design, Store Operations) and external partners (brokers, landlords, developers). This role ensures all site packages meet corporate standards, adhere to timelines, and move seamlessly through the Real Estate Committee (REC) approval process. They support the planning, execution, and day-to-day coordination of real estate projects, helping keep day-to-day activities and projects organized and on track as well as consolidating and preparing market & store visit materials. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Compile, audit, and maintain comprehensive site approval packages, for executive review, including market demographics, lease summaries, sales projections, site plans, preliminary construction budgets, proforma and deal terms.
* Manage the agenda, tracking logs, and presentation materials for weekly or monthly REC meetings.
* Track conditions of approval post-REC and ensure all contingencies are satisfied prior to legal documentation.
* Launch projects internally with design and construction partners.
* Work with market analysis tools to gather required demographic information and full portfolio market plan development to support of the RE Directors
* Act as initial point of contact for Real Estate with landlords and obtain project set-up sheets, drawings, photos, Landlord work schedules, tenant criteria, and other materials
* Collaborate with Architect/Design and Construction teams on management of Landlord construction documents, Landlord work schedules and other construction related items
* Assist Real Estate Directors in tracking possession timing and collaborate with Construction on Landlord work completion
* Obtain and document Landlord Possession letters
* Manage files, organize paperwork and responsible for minutes/REC Outcomes share out internally
* Managing incoming LL contacts, and schedule meetings as needed to facilitate store pipeline
* Assist in preparation for ICSC conferences and other team activities

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* BA Degree in a related field
* 3-5 years of experience, preferably in Real Estate
* Intermediate to advanced Word, Excel and PowerPoint
* Understanding of the fundamental budgeting processes and controls
* Strong administration/organization / interpersonal skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to prioritize workload, manage and adhere to deadlines and work autonomously as well as be a team player

The base salary range for this position is $85,000-$95,000 per year which represents the current range for the base salary for this exempt position. Please note that actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. As such, on occasion and when applicable, there is the possibility that the final, agreed-upon base salary may be outside of the upper end of the range. Please also note the range listed is just one component of the company's total rewards package for exempt employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, long term incentives, a PTO policy, and many other progressive benefits.

jobs.title: Social Media and Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About MILKBARN**

MILKBARN creates baby and children's clothing, accessories, nursery essentials and gifts inspired by childhood imagination and original prints. We want to build lasting connections with families through warm, distinctive brand storytelling.

milkbarnkids.com

**The role**

We are looking for a Social Media & Influencer Marketing coordinator to bring MILKBARN's stories to life for U.S. audiences. You will own social content planning and execution, creator partnerships and community engagement. This hands-on role includes writing, everyday video production and performance analysis to grow brand awareness, meaningful engagement and qualified website traffic.

**What you will do**

· **Plan social content.** Build a monthly calendar around our audience, brand voice, product launches and seasonal moments. Prioritize Instagram and develop other relevant channels according to business needs and performance.

· **Create content.** Turn original prints, fabric details, styling, gifting and everyday family moments into compelling stories. Write English copy, shoot and edit everyday short-form video, and develop clear briefs for professional shoots.

· **Manage channels and community.** Publish content, engage with comments and messages, and maintain a consistent visual identity and voice. Capture customer insights and route order or service issues to the appropriate colleagues.

· **Run creator partnerships.** Identify parenting, family and lifestyle creators whose audiences fit the brand. Manage outreach, gifting, briefs, reviews and publishing, tracking timelines and results within agreed budgets.

· **Build a usable content library.** Source authentic customer stories and user-generated content. Coordinate usage permissions, partnership disclosures and relevant image releases, and organize assets for social, e-commerce and other marketing activity.

· **Support launches and campaigns.** Coordinate with e-commerce on product availability, campaign timing, destination pages and tracking links. Create content that helps people discover products and take the next step toward purchase.

· **Measure and improve.** Analyze relevant reach, video viewing, saves and shares, audience growth, website traffic and creator results. Recommend changes to content and partnerships, and share audience insights with e-commerce and merchandising colleagues.

**What you bring**

· 3+ years of experience in social media, content or influencer marketing, including consumer brand accounts serving the U.S. market.

· Strong practical knowledge of Instagram and the ability to take work from idea and copy through production, publishing and review. Sound judgment about adapting content for other platforms.

· Excellent English writing, storytelling and visual judgment, with the ability to translate product features into natural, engaging content that fits the brand.

· The ability to independently shoot and edit everyday short-form video and create simple visual assets using tools such as Canva, CapCut, Adobe or equivalents.

· Experience identifying, contacting and managing creators, assessing audience fit and content quality, and reviewing performance using platform insights and tracked links.

· Strong project coordination and communication skills. Ability to work on-site at our future LA office with regular in-office attendance and participate in product and content shoots.

**Preferred experience**

· Experience with baby or children's apparel, children's products, parenting or family lifestyle brands, with an understanding of U.S. parents, caregivers and gift shoppers.

· Relevant creator relationships or examples of growth through content series, community programs or creator partnerships.

· Experience with Pinterest, TikTok, Facebook or other relevant channels, or with paid-social creative, licensed creator assets and small-scale content promotion tests.

**How success will be measured**

Success will be evaluated through content quality and consistency, target-audience reach, meaningful engagement, community growth, qualified website traffic, and the content and commercial value of creator partnerships. Specific goals will reflect channel baselines, budgets and production resources.

Pay: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Parental leave

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Glendale, CA 91206

jobs.description:
Day to day life has room for improvement.

That was our basic thinking when we founded Simplehuman in 2000. Our mission is to bring high-performance innovation to basic but essential tasks in our daily routine. Through new technologies, meticulous engineering and an obsession for improvement, we find new and better ways to achieve basic but important daily tasks.

**About the role**

We are seeking an Amazon Sales Coordinator to support the day to day operations of Simplehuman's Amazon business across the US (Amazon.com) and Canada (Amazon.ca). Reporting to the Sr. Amazon Account Manager of North America, you will keep listings accurate, purchase orders moving, inventory healthy and reporting on time, so the account team can focus on growth and strategy. This role is based in our Torrance headquarters, and the ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly organized and comfortable managing many moving parts across two marketplaces.

**Responsibilities**

* Support the day to day management of the Amazon US and Canada accounts through Vendor Central and Seller Central.
* Process and track purchase orders, confirm shipments and follow up on open issues with Amazon, the Operations team and our US and CA distribution centers.

* Monitor inventory levels, fill rates and in-stock position, and flag risks to the account managers and planning team.
* Research and resolve chargebacks, shortages, deductions and compliance issues, and file disputes and support cases as needed.
* Coordinate promotions and deals (SnS, coupons and Prime Day/holiday events), including setup, tracking and post-event recaps.
* Support Amazon Advertising campaigns (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display) with campaign setup, budget tracking and performance reporting.
* Prepare weekly and monthly sales, inventory and advertising reports, and help analyze trends and competitive activity.
* Act as a point of contact for vendor manager and Seller Support communication, keeping cases organized and moving to resolution.
* Partner with marketing, creative and customer service teams to keep brand standards and product information consistent across the US and Canada.

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing or a related field.
* 3 - 5 years of experience supporting an Amazon business, in e-commerce operations or in retail account coordination.
* Hands-on experience with Amazon Vendor Central and/or Seller Central; Amazon Advertising experience a plus.
* Experience with Amazon.com and Amazon.ca or another international Amazon marketplace a strong plus.
* Working knowledge of purchase orders, EDI, retailer compliance and chargeback management.
* Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP) and comfort working with large data sets.
* Exceptional attention to detail and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Clear, professional communication skills and a proactive, team-first approach.
* Experience in premium consumer products or housewares a strong plus.

  

**About Us**

We're a mature company with the soul of a start-up. We value ingenuity, precise communications, fast iteration and scrappiness. Our teams are tight-knit with a work hard, play hard tradition – we take pride in individual and team success and push boundaries to make the best products. And we only build products we love to use ourselves. Great benefits, competitive compensation, and generous Simplehuman product discounts.

**Job Title:** Designer and Project Coordinator

**Location:** Berkeley, California. In person at the studio.

**Reports to:** Project lead; Principal

**Position type:** Full time

**FLSA status:** Nonexempt

**Schedule:** Monday trough Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM

**Compensation:** $45 to $55 per hour. Overtime eligible.

**Start date:** December orJanuary 2027

**1. ABOUT Company:**

Company was founded to meet a growing need: a better way to design and build. The practice is based in the San Francisco Bay Area and provides architecture, interiors, design build, construction management, landscape, advisory, and development services. One multidisciplinary team of architects, designers, builders, managers, and strategists carries each project from idea to built work.

The firm is advancing a more integrated model of design build delivery, in which the people who design a project stay with it through construction, so that design intent carries from the first drawing to the finished building without a handoff.

The firm takes on residences, restaurants, hospitality, adaptive reuse, and multifamily projects, from ground up buildings to tenant improvements and small projects. Construction is performed by General Contractors, a licensed builder with its own build team and its own millwork.

**2. ROLE:**

The Designer and Project Coordinator is a design professional who supports project delivery across design and construction phases within the firm's architect led design build team. With a foundation in architectural training and a curiosity for building processes, this individual leads the firm's Revit modeling and visualization work and plays a key role in project documentation, consultant coordination, and jobsite integration.

The role offers exposure to all phases of project development, with mentorship from experienced Project Leads and the goal of leading a small project within the first year. It is an opportunity for someone who values organization, craft, and progressive design solutions and is interested in a fast paced, collaborative environment. Approximately 65 percent of the role is design and documentation, and 35 percent is project coordination and construction support.

**3. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Design and documentation**

* Develop design drawings, permit sets, and construction documents.
* Lead BIM development in Revit, and maintain the firm's Revit templates and standards.
* Develop and manage 3D digital models in Rhino under direction of the Project Lead.
* Create and manage presentation materials, including diagrams, models, and renderings.
* Contribute to drawing coordination with consultants and the internal team.
* Measure and document existing conditions in the field.

**Project coordination**

* Maintain and update project files, schedules, and design documentation.
* Track consultant deliverables, permit submittals, and project milestones.
* Participate in internal design reviews, client meetings, and consultant coordination calls.
* Support material research, specification development, and procurement tracking.
* Assemble bid packages and track subcontractor responses.

**Construction support**

* Attend job site visits and assist with field documentation, including photos, notes, and punch lists.
* Help manage RFIs, submittals, and construction correspondence.
* Translate field feedback into design updates and revisions.
* Collaborate with trades and site staff under supervision of the Project Lead.

**4. QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in architecture.
* Minimum of five years of professional experience in architecture or construction.
* Advanced proficiency in Revit, and working knowledge of Rhino.
* Proficiency in rendering tools such as V-Ray and Enscape, and familiarity with Adobe CreativeSuite.
* Interest in both design and building processes, with a desire to grow across disciplines.
* Strong organizational and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and follow direction.

**5. KEY TRAITS FOR SUCCESS:**

* Design intuition: You have proven design excellence, verified through a portfolio, and you want to learn more and expand your design philosophy and approach.
* Growth mentality: You are eager to learn, ask questions, receive feedback, and expand your skills.
* Integrity: You show up, follow through, and hold yourself accountable every day. You take pride in your work and look for ways to improve it.
* Self starter: You take initiative and look for ways to improve or contribute.
* Team mentality: You support others and ask for help when needed. You recognize that no task is too small, and you go above and beyond to help others.
* Curiosity for design build: You want to understand how drawings become buildings and how building informs drawings.

**6. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**

* Pay range of $45 to $55 per hour. Placement within the range is based on experience and qualifications.
* Nonexempt position, eligible for overtime pay in accordance with California law.
* Eligible for performance bonuses.
* Eligible to participate in the firm's 401(k) plan and health coverage, subject to the terms of each plan.
* Competitive paid time off.

**7. GROWTH PATHWAY:**

* A formal performance review at twelve months, against written criteria.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative, Healthcare
jobs.description:
Sunnyvale, CA

**OLOID · Sunnyvale, CA · Full time**

Hospitals run on shared workstations and badge taps, and every tap is a login. That is the problem OLOID solves, and it is why health systems are the natural next market after its Fortune 500 manufacturing and retail customers. This seat owns top of funnel for that patch, sitting alongside a dedicated healthcare enterprise seller.

**How we sell**
---------------

We have built a modern selling motion and you will have the tech stack you would expect. You open the organisational conversations it runs on, multi threading across clinical, security, IT and executive buyers, and every meeting you book is qualified to MEDDPICC standards. You are the designated BDR for an enterprise seller and work as a true partner with them and with pre sales, and the wins are shared across the team.

**Why now**
-----------

2027 is a big year. Revenue is up 600 percent since the Series A and we are going after seven figure enterprise deals. Microsoft retires SMS and voice MFA in Entra ID in February 2027, which pushes every enterprise toward exactly what we sell. Healthcare is the next big market, and Aura, our AI identity assurance agent, is already part of Workday’s Agent System of Record.

**A lean team with real ownership**
-----------------------------------

This is a lean commercial team reporting into our core executive team. You own your patch and your number end to end, with real influence over how we sell and who joins next.

**Is this you?**
----------------

It is not for the faint hearted. You will wear many hats, build pipeline without a big machine behind you, and make calls without a playbook. If you have sold in a high growth environment and bring a growth mindset, you will thrive here, at a genuinely exciting moment for the company.

**Why OLOID**
-------------

OLOID builds passwordless identity for frontline workers and shared devices: the nurse, the line worker, the store associate who moves between shared workstations all shift, often with no work smartphone. They sign in with a face, a badge tap or NFC, layered onto Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Identity and the systems a company already runs. Tyson Foods, PepsiCo, GE, Takeda, Flex and Honeywell are customers, and we are backed by Dell Technologies Capital, Okta Ventures and Honeywell Ventures.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Own top of funnel for healthcare: roughly 60 percent cold outbound, 40 percent warm leads and inbound
* Build target lists of the people worth reaching inside health systems, and multi thread rather than firing at one contact
* Run outreach across calling, email and social, and qualify inbound from events and campaigns
* Book meetings and demos, brief the account executive properly, and work as their partner through the deal
* Mine the CRM for new needs in prospects already there

**What you bring**
------------------

* 1 to 3 years in lead generation, sales or marketing, with at least 12 months of real outbound
* A genuine understanding of how US health systems buy and who signs
* A methodical, research first approach. Twenty researched messages beat two hundred sprayed ones
* Based in the Bay Area, or ready to relocate
* Resilience. There are a lot of no answers, and patience matters more than polish

**Great if you also have**
--------------------------

A bachelor’s degree is preferred, not required. People who do this well move into product, pre sales and customer facing roles, and OLOID will build toward that deliberately.

**Where you work**
------------------

Full time in our Sunnyvale office. You must live in the San Francisco Bay Area or be prepared to relocate. We are investing in building an in person team at our Sunnyvale hub.

**Pay and the rest**
--------------------

Guideline base $80,000 to $90,000, $110,000 on target, set on experience. Medical insurance, 401k and unlimited vacation. Equity is part of every offer. You must be authorised to work in the US without employer visa sponsorship, now or in the future. OLOID is an equal opportunity employer.

**Interview stages**
--------------------

* **Intro call with our talent team.** About 30 minutes on your background, your track record and what you are looking for.

* **First interview with the hiring manager.** How you prospect, how you qualify and how you work as a true partner with your AE.

* **Pipeline walkthrough with commercial leadership.** Take us through pipeline you built: your outreach, the meetings you booked and how you qualified them.

* **Final conversation with our executive team.** Where you want to take your career, and how you would help build what comes next.

You will hear where you stand at every stage.

**Come ready**
--------------

Be confident in your past successes and ready to walk the team through them: the pipeline you built, the meetings you booked and what they turned into. We will ask for specifics, so bring them.

jobs.title: Brand Marketing & Community Lead
jobs.description:
Full-time, in-office in New York or San Francisco.

**About Corridor**
------------------

Corridor is the first AI-native benefits brokerage. We believe AI changes the economics of exceptional service, and we're building toward a world where every business gets the expertise and attention once reserved for the largest companies.

We're early and backed by Bain Capital Ventures. One thing is already clear: our customers love us. This role exists to turn that love into a brand people know and a community people want to be part of.

**The role**
------------

You'll be our first brand marketing and community hire, owning how the world sees Corridor and who wants to be around it. You'll work directly with our growth lead and founders, and you'll have real ownership from day one.

This isn't a coordinator seat. We want someone who has built a brand or an audience, run campaigns that moved people, and brought the right people into a room. You'll do that for a company early enough to shape it, and grow into leading brand and community as the team grows.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Own the story.** Sharpen our positioning, voice and look across the site, social and sales materials, working with our designers.
* **Make customers the hero.** Turn customer love into stories, video and proof that people actually share.
* **Build the community.** Bring together founders, operators and people leaders who trust each other and trust us. Make it something people ask to join.
* **Create experiences.** Dinners, small gatherings and a few bigger moments a year, with the details done right.
* **Run launches and campaigns.** Plan and ship integrated campaigns across content, social, video and press.
* **Build brand partnerships.** Lead the co-marketing partnerships we have in the works and land new ones with companies, creators and media we admire.
* **Know what's working.** Track whether brand and community are landing, from awareness to the customers, partners and hires who come through them.
* **Scale yourself with AI.** Use agents and tools to do the work of a much bigger team.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 4+ years in brand marketing, product marketing or marketing at a media company, including time at an early-stage startup.
* You've built a brand or an audience of your own, like a creator account, newsletter or event series, and you know what makes people pay attention and show up.
* You've run integrated campaigns across content, social, video or events, and you can show what they did.
* You can turn a complex product into a simple story people repeat.
* A strong writer with real taste. You know when a headline, a deck or a dinner table is off.
* Social and well connected in New York or San Francisco, and you like being the person who brings people together.
* You already use AI to scale your own work, and you're curious about where it goes next.
* No healthcare, insurance or benefits background needed. We'd rather you bring a different perspective.

**What success looks like in year one**
---------------------------------------

* People in our market can tell you what Corridor stands for, in words that sound like ours.
* Customer stories that founders and operators have seen and passed along.
* A community and event series with a waitlist, not an invite list we have to chase.
* Launches that get talked about, not just posted.
* Customers, partners and hires we can trace back to your work.

**Process**
-----------

Our process includes a short case on a real problem we're working on, so you can see how we think and we can see how you do.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager, Affordable Housing
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

San Francisco Housing Development Corporation (SFHDC) seeks an Assistant Project Manager to advance the development and preservation of affordable housing in San Francisco.

About SFHDC

Black community leaders, led by Geraldine Johnson, founded SFHDC in 1988 to counter the displacement that 1960s and 1970s redevelopment caused for African American residents and other communities of color. Our mission is to foster financial stability through the development of affordable housing, the facilitation of homeownership, and the economic empowerment and revitalization of Bayview Hunters Point, the Fillmore, and other San Francisco neighborhoods.

We carry out this mission through four core programs: Affordable Housing Development, Resident Services, Financial Empowerment, and Economic Development.

**Real Estate Development.** The department develops and preserves a diverse portfolio of affordable housing and maintains an active pipeline of new projects. The portfolio spans new construction, redevelopment, and preservation, including ownership and rental homes, a cooperative housing property, and properties converted under the federal Rental Assistance Demonstration (RAD) program.

About the role

The Assistant Project Manager works alongside a Project Manager to deliver multiple affordable housing developments, including new construction and the rehabilitation and preservation of existing properties. Most projects are financed with Low-Income Housing Tax Credits (LIHTC), a federal program that provides tax credits to investors in exchange for equity in affordable rental housing, together with other public and private funding sources.

This entry-level position is designed to develop future project managers. The successful candidate will gain experience across the full development process, take on increasing responsibility over time, and follow a defined path to Project Manager.

Key responsibilities

Under the direction of the Project Manager, the Assistant Project Manager will:

· **Prepare funding applications.** Help assemble applications to MOHCD, the California Tax Credit Allocation Committee, and other public and private sources. Gather site plans, budgets, and partner letters, draft narrative sections for review, and check each submission against funder requirements.

· **Maintain project trackers and records.** Own the permit and approvals tracker, from Planning Department review through Department of Building Inspection (DBI) permits, monitor status with City staff, and flag potential delays to the Project Manager. Keep project files, schedules, and correspondence current.

· **Process monthly payment requests.** Reconcile contractor invoices to the approved budget to prepare monthly payment requests to lenders and public funders, and track the documentation required for loan closings.

· **Track project risks.** Keep the project risk log, identify potential funding, compliance, budget, and schedule issues, such as unmet lender conditions, delayed permits, or cost overruns, and escalate them to the Project Manager with relevant documentation.

· **Coordinate partner and community meetings.** Join the Project Manager in meetings with co-developers, lenders, and investors, and at public hearings and community meetings. Prepare materials and updates, take notes, and track follow-up items.

· **Update budgets and financial models.** Keep project budgets current and, as skills develop, run scenario analyses in Excel-based financial models.

· **Participate in site visits.** Visit construction sites and existing properties to document conditions and progress.

· **Assist with project closeout.** Assemble closeout documentation and help transition completed buildings to operations, in coordination with SFHDC’s Resident Services team.

The Assistant Project Manager also contributes to special projects, including process and tool improvements, and performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

**Required**

· Bachelor’s degree.

· One to two years of project management experience, or equivalent experience managing deadlines, budgets, and multiple stakeholders.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to draft accurate correspondence, reports, and funding narratives, and to present information to internal and external stakeholders.

· Demonstrated organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities across multiple projects.

· Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Drive).

· Commitment to affordable housing and community development.

· Valid California driver’s license, a reliable vehicle, and proof of auto insurance.

**Preferred**

· Experience with Excel financial modeling.

· Knowledge of automation technology, such as workflow automation, e-signature, or project management software.

· Proficiency with AI tools to research topics, prepare first drafts of narratives and correspondence, and analyze data.

· Coursework or experience in planning, real estate, construction, finance, or public policy.

· Knowledge of San Francisco neighborhoods, particularly Bayview Hunters Point and the Fillmore.

Schedule and work location

· Full-time, 35 hours per week (five 7-hour days).

· Hybrid: two days per week in the San Francisco office (94124); remaining days remote or at project sites.

· Occasional evening public hearings and community meetings.

· Periodic local travel to project sites within San Francisco in a personal vehicle; mileage is reimbursed.

Physical requirements

Site visits require climbing stairs, accessing rooftops and basements, and walking on uneven surfaces at construction sites and existing buildings. Office work requires extended periods at a computer. SFHDC provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.

**Job Description**

The Bureau of Alcohol and Drug Use (BADU) works to close gaps and reduce overall morbidity and mortality related to alcohol and substance use among New Yorkers. BADU develops, implements, and evaluates interventions and prevention strategies through contracting of treatment, recovery and support services; policy analysis and development; epidemiology and surveillance; dissemination of treatment and management guidelines; harm reduction initiatives; public and provider outreach and education; and community involvement and interagency collaboration. The Bureau amplifies the voices of those most impacted and focuses on inequitable structural, social, service, and communication factors that drive disparities.
  
  
The Health Care Provider Initiatives (HCPI) unit within BADU promotes high-impact alcohol and drug-related best practices in medical settings to reduce morbidity and mortality from drugs and alcohol.
  
HCPI implements initiatives focused on increasing buprenorphine demand and access, increasing naloxone access, educating providers on non-opioid drugs, increasing guideline-concordant opioid and benzodiazepine prescribing, and enhancing substance use education among NYC clinical trainees. **ABOUT US:** - We believe that everyone deserves a home!
  
  
Breaking Ground operates nearly 4,000 units of housing across New York City, along with housing in upstate New York and Connecticut. Supportive housing - affordable housing paired with services designed to help people maintain their homes for the long-term - is widely recognized as a proven and cost-effective solution to chronic homelessness.
  
  
But we didn't stop at providing housing. Breaking Ground's programs and services help people experiencing street homelessness - especially those who have been on the streets the longest - to come indoors. Through our Street to Home outreach program and transitional housing resources, we help people get, and stay, on the path to a permanent home.
  
  
Reporting to the Assistant Program Director, Tenant Success Services, the Program Coordinator, Tenant Success Services provides supervisory oversight to a new and growing team of Housing Retention Specialists using a Critical Time Intervention (CTI)-informed model; providing time-limited services focused on housing retention, resource development, and community integration with the goal of helping formerly homeless individuals and families prevent eviction and return to shelter.
  
These services are provided to individuals and families exiting the shelter system and moving into apartments in new developments located in Brooklyn, Queens, and Manhattan. The Program Coordinator collaborates with Tenant Services Coordinators who provide ongoing community support to these individuals and families following the first year of tenancy. The Program Coordinator is responsible for ensuring that service provision is of the highest quality and is consistent with CTI-informed principles.
  
Depending on program need, this position may carry a small caseload of more complex clients. The Program Coordinator liaises with community stakeholders, funders, property management, and real estate development companies, and serves as a member of the Light Touch Services’ management team.

jobs.description:
Salary: $65,000

Reports To: Assistant Director, Career Exploration & Readiness Continuum

Hours: Monday through Friday, 35 hours per week, including some evening hours to support Hub programming; occasional weekend hours as needed.

About The Door

The Door has served as one of New York City’s most trusted places for teens and young adults for more than 50 years. The Door’s mission is to empower young people to reach their potential by providing comprehensive youth development services in a diverse and caring environment.

A nationally recognized model for holistic youth support, The Door reaches up to 10,000 young people annually through a wide range of free, co-located services. Youth ages 12 to 24 can access health care and health education, mental health counseling and crisis intervention, legal services, career and education programming, housing supports, services for runaway and homeless youth, arts and recreational programming, and nutritious daily meals, all under one roof. The majority of youth served are navigating systemic barriers, including disconnection from school or work, housing instability, and involvement in foster care or the justice system.

Within this model, The Door operates a robust Career and Education Services Department (CareerED), including general work-readiness training and 14 sector-based workforce programs aligned with high-demand industries such as construction, green jobs, healthcare, information technology, retail, culinary arts, theater production, and commercial driving. These programs combine technical training, industry-recognized credentials, paid internships, and job placement support, in partnership with institutions such as CUNY and leading employers.

About the Youth Exploration & Career Navigation Hub

In Fall 2026, The Door will launch NYC’s first Youth Exploration & Career Navigation Hub (the Hub). The Hub addresses a longstanding citywide gap: while NYC has invested heavily in education, workforce, and youth services, the broader system remains fragmented, difficult to navigate, and not designed around how young people explore options, make decisions, and move forward over time.

The Hub is a welcoming, youth-centered space where young people can walk in, get paired with a dedicated Citywide Career Navigator, explore their interests and goals, and receive warm connections to best-fit education, training, and employment opportunities across NYC.

Onsite, the Hub also offers a Career Exploration & Readiness Continuum consisting of four immediate-entry and stackable pathways: immersive Virtual Reality career exploration with Transfr; a Career Readiness Certificate workshop series; the six-week Transfr Trek cohort; and the seven-week Mesa Alumni Lab cohort. The Continuum is designed so that young people can begin exploring and building momentum immediately rather than waiting for the next program or cohort to begin.

A defining feature of the Hub is its commitment to ongoing support and returnability. Young people are never rejected, never exited simply because a pathway did not work out, and are always welcomed back without stigma. The Hub operates on a “No Eject, No Reject” philosophy.

Position Overview

The Intake & Operations Coordinator will serve as one of the first welcoming faces young people encounter when entering the Hub and will play a critical role in making sure every young person is quickly connected to a meaningful next step.

After a young person completes The Door’s membership intake, or when an existing Door member comes to the Hub seeking career or education support, the coordinator will welcome them, understand what they are looking for, and help connect them to the appropriate Hub staff member or program. Depending on the young person’s needs and availability, this may include a Citywide Career Navigator, Employment Specialist, one of the Career Exploration & Readiness Continuum pathways, or an immediate Transfr VR career exploration experience while they wait for another service to become available.

The coordinator will also manage critical day-to-day Hub operations, including participant flow, waitlists, scheduling, cohort enrollment coordination, Transfr headset management, and basic program tracking. When appropriate, the coordinator will help young people begin exploring careers through Transfr VR so that no young person enters the Hub and is left without something meaningful to engage in.

This role requires someone who is exceptionally organized and responsible while also being warm, approachable, flexible, and highly skilled at engaging young adults. The ideal candidate believes that the way a young person is greeted and supported in their first few minutes can shape their willingness to trust the Hub and come back.

Why This Role Matters

The Hub is designed around a simple principle: a young person should be able to walk in, engage immediately, and begin moving forward on their journey that day. The Hub will be the first place in New York City where young people can walk in and immediately engage in exploration/readiness programming and receive 1:1 career advising and navigation support.

That promise depends on strong coordination behind the scenes. Young people may arrive with very different needs, at different stages of readiness, and without knowing exactly what they are looking for. Navigators or Employment Specialists may be meeting with other young people, and cohort-based programs may not begin immediately.

The Intake & Operations Coordinator makes sure those realities never translate into a young person feeling ignored, confused, or turned away. This person will create a warm front door, keep the Hub organized and responsive, and help ensure that every young person leaves their initial interaction knowing what happens next.

Primary Responsibilities

Youth Welcome, Engagement & Hub Navigation

* Serve as a warm, welcoming first point of contact for young people entering the Youth Exploration & Caree

We’re looking for a Production Coordinator to support the planning and execution of experiential projects for CPG brands. Working closely with Producers, creative, strategy, account, and production teams, you’ll help ensure projects run smoothly from initial planning through to on-site execution. This role involves frequent and consistent travel to support production needs, site visits, and on-site execution.

* Coordinate vendors, fabricators, venues, staffing, logistics, and production partners.

* Track deliverables, approvals, deadlines, and production milestones.
* Support on-site production, installation, execution, and breakdown.
* Help track project progress, flag potential challenges, and keep teams informed.
* Assist with estimates, proposals, scopes, and production planning.
* Organize project files, documentation, and administrative details.
* Support production workflows, processes, and best practices.
* Travel regularly for site visits and on-site production and execution.

### **What You'll Bring**

* Production coordination experience within an experiential agency, creative studio, or similar environment.
* Familiarity with activations, events, pop-ups, and live brand experiences.
* Experience working with CPG brands or an interest in consumer marketing.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to coordinate timelines, schedules, deliverables, and project documentation.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Proactive problem-solving skills and resourcefulness.
* A collaborative approach and ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
* Comfortable supporting on-site production, installation, execution, and breakdown.
* Ability and willingness to travel consistently for productions, site visits, and company events. A valid passport and driver's licence are required.

### **Additional Info**

* Monday - Thursday in office (Fridays are remote optional)
* Flexible time off, including paid vacation and sick days
* Consistent culture and team-building events
* Employee recognition and incentive programs
* Seasonal celebrations and gatherings throughout the year
* Office lunches
* Branded company swag
* Access to industry events, learning opportunities, and non-profit outreaches
* Dog-friendly offices
* Unlimited coffee, drinks, and snacks
* Flex work and travel options
* Comprehensive extended health benefits

Placement in the salary range will be based on factors such as internal equity, candidate experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the role. If your compensation expectations fall outside of this range, we still welcome your application.

**Equal Opportunity**  
At Thinkingbox, we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to thrive. We believe that diversity is our creative strength – it's the range of perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds that fuels our best ideas and most innovative solutions. We welcome and encourage applicants of all races, ethnicities, genders, identities, abilities, ages, sexual orientations, and backgrounds to apply. Your voice matters here.

**To Apply**  
Thank you for your interest in joining our team. Please submit your resume along with links to your online portfolio as part of your application (if applicable). Due to the volume of applications we receive, we’re unable to respond to every submission. However, all applications are kept in our talent database and will be considered for future opportunities.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Community Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
W.A.R.M (We All Really Matter) is a not-for-profit organization of domestic violence survivors along with their allies who are committed to ending violence against women and children in the Harlem community. Our primary goal is to empower survivors through a holistic approach, focusing on the body, mind, and spirit. W.A.R.M seeks full time, client centered community outreach coordinators to support the needs of survivors on their path to safety and independence.

  

Community Outreach Coordinators (COC) act as the first line of contact between WARM and the Harlem community bringing education / awareness about domestic violence and information about WARM’s services to the Community Outreach Coordinators need to be strong in the following three areas: Interpersonal Skills, Cultural Sensitivity and Problem-Solving.

Interpersonal skills, both verbal and written, are very important, as they must be able to work closely with the NYPD, community-based organizations, victims/survivors of domestic violence and others while listening carefully to their concerns and answering their questions. Cultural sensitivity is key because as an outreach worker you may be working with different ethnic groups. Problem solving skills are necessary since community outreach coordinators deal with problems daily and domestic violence is a crisis-oriented issue. Community outreach coordinators must be personable, able to educate others, possess good writing skills to develop materials and document their activities accurately; able to safely operate a motor vehicle and handle WARM’s transportation responsibility. The community outreach coordinator is often a member of the community he/she serves or has shared experiences that increase their credibility and understanding of the issues people face. Related work experience is encouraged. Proficiency in a second language is preferred (Spanish).

### **Key Responsibilities**

Professional Conduct

Community Outreach

Administrative Support and Logistics

* Always represent the WARM organization with dignity and respect.

* Adhere to workplace policies and procedures, including confidentiality, documentation, channels of communication, culture, dress code, and conflict resolution.

* Ability to discuss WARM services & resources.

* Build relationships with other community organizations.

* Attend community board meetings, NYPD meetings, etc.

* Post flyers in various communities.

* Conduct presentations in churches and other local businesses.

* Monitor daily/weekly/monthly schedule of all outreach activities/events.

* Prepare literature packets, PPE kits, and any other items for events.

* Create sign-in sheets for all events.

* Input completed sign-in sheets into spreadsheet per event.

* Assemble outreach bags each day.

* Assist the community with filling out all forms.

* Record immediate referrals and report to staff immediately.

* Ability to do pick-ups, drop-offs, and other transportation-related activities.

* Pick up and drop off donations to external storage unit.

* Maintain upkeep & inventory of external storage unit.

* Perform administrative duties, filing, database entry, restocking.

* Report to supervisor.

### **Qualifications**

* Knowledge of domestic violence issues, including challenges and services needs

  

Innovative with effective brainstorming techniques

Empathetic with a commitment to assist, relate to and effectively work with other women recovering from a domestic violence situation

2- or 4-year college degree

Familiarity with Microsoft Suite including Word, Excel and PowerPoint

Typing 55 words or more a minute

Valid Driver’s license; clean driving record

Organized and detail oriented

Good verbal and written communications, effective interpersonal skills

Spanish speaking - highly considered, but not required

**Email resume and cover letter with contact information and two professional references to** **weallreallymatter@gmail.com**

$55,000

Full-time Position

jobs.title: Regional Outreach Coordinator - Queens, NY (Part-time)
jobs.description:
**About Muslim Aid USA**

Muslim Aid USA (MAUSA) is a faith-based American international charity working alongside diverse communities to aid, advocate, and empower people to build sustainable futures for generations to come. Guided by our Islamic faith, we respond to humanitarian needs and address the underlying challenges that prevent individuals and communities from thriving.

We envision a world where every person, in every community, has the resources to thrive with dignity. Our work is grounded in five core values — Dignity (Karamah), Justice (Adl), Excellence (Ihsan), Compassion (Rahma), and Service (Khidma) — which guide how we serve communities, collaborate, and hold ourselves accountable to the highest standards of impact and integrity.

MAUSA serves people of all backgrounds and faiths, honoring the dignity, agency, and potential of every person and community we have the privilege to serve.

**Position Summary**

The Regional Outreach Coordinator is Muslim Aid USA’s community mobilizer in Queens. Working full-time or part-time, the coordinator builds relationships with donors, local religious institutions, diaspora groups, professional groups, campuses, and community organizations. The coordinator also recruits and coaches peer-to-peer fundraisers, forms host committees, and fills MAUSA’s events, iftars, and private gatherings.

**Alignment with MAUSA Values**

The Coordinator embodies MAUSA’s Core Values of **Dignity (Karamah), Justice (Adl), Excellence (Ihsan), Compassion (Rahma), and Service (Khidma)** by treating others with respect and empathy, promoting fairness and inclusion, demonstrating accountability and a commitment to excellence, and approaching their work with a service-oriented mindset aligned with MAUSA’s Mission and Vision.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

Community Mobilization & Partnerships

  

* Build lasting relationships with donors, mosques/key leadership, diaspora groups, professional groups, Campus Student Associations, and community organizations across Queens.
* Form and support host committees of key community members and advocates for events and private gatherings.
* Represent MAUSA at community events and bring visibility to communities where MAUSA is not yet known.
* Share community feedback and stories with the Development team to strengthen MAUSA’s campaigns.

Fundraising & Events

  

* Recruit, coach, and support local peer-to-peer fundraisers, especially during high giving seasons.
* Fill venues for MAUSA events, galas, iftars, and private gatherings.
* Ask for support with confidence, follow up promptly, and connect potential major donors with the Director of Development.
* Lead MAUSA’s local Ramadan activity, which in the first year includes a regional iftar, several mosque appeals, and a team of peer-to-peer fundraisers.

Data & Accountability

  

* Record every contact, pledge, and relationship within the CRM and follow up on time.
* Keep campaign dashboards up to date and take part in regular group check-ins.
* Work toward targets set for the market’s maturity and the role’s hours.

**Qualifications**

Minimum Qualifications

  

* Deeply connected and active in the Queens Muslim community, with relationships across mosques, community organizations, or diaspora groups, etc.
* A natural organizer who can mobilize people and fill a room.
* Credible and respected with community members across generations.
* Comfortable asking for support and following up.
* Organized and reliable, with the ability to keep accurate records in a CRM; training is provided.
* Strong communication skills for faith-based and general audiences.
* Available for evening and weekend work, especially during Ramadan and major campaigns, and able to travel within Queens and nearby communities.

Preferred Qualifications

  

* Experience in fundraising, event planning, community organizing, or peer-to-peer campaigns/crowdfunding.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, Google Workspace, and Slack.
* Experience in a faith-based or Islamic nonprofit environment.

**What We Offer**

  

* Pay: Part-time, $24-$29 (hourly, non-exempt), depending on experience
* Training in Salesforce, MAUSA’s programs, and community fundraising, with regular coaching
* A place on MAUSA’s first regional team, helping shape how the regional model grows
* Purpose-driven, faith-centered work with national impact

**How to Apply**

Submit your application by **December 15, 2026**, including:

  

* Your resume
* A brief cover letter explaining your interest in the role and how your experience aligns with MAUSA’s Mission, Vision, and Values
* A brief overview of your relevant experience in community outreach, relationship building, and engagement

The Coordinator will work closely with the partners and help the Business Development Associate Director and team in business planning to assist in driving the business development strategy of the assigned practice groups and lawyers, and on other tasks as they pertain to the maintenance and growth of the practice.

jobs.title: Customer Strategy & Operations Specialist

**About the Company**

Passage Health is a fast-growing Series A startup on a mission to improve the quality and accessibility of autism care through technology. Autism diagnosis rates have surged over the past decade to 1 in 31 children, yet families still face waitlists of up to a year for care as providers—hampered by antiquated technology and manual workflows—struggle to meet surging demand.

We’re building the platform that modernizes how autism care providers work—from clinical documentation to operations to billing—transforming how care is delivered and scaling access across a $460B market.

Over the past year, Passage has grown more than 3x, driven by strong customer demand and expanding partnerships across the autism care ecosystem. As we scale, we’re focused on building durable foundations—the systems, processes, and decision-making needed to support long-term growth.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

As our Customer Strategy & Operations Specialist, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping how Passage delivers value to our largest customers. This is an opportunity to build the operating backbone of our customer function: running complex, multi-site deployments, owning the metrics that define customer success, and turning what you learn in the field into scalable playbooks and product improvements. You’ll navigate ambiguity with a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Clinical teams to make every launch faster and better than the last.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **Program Management:** Own implementations and rollouts for our largest customers end to end, including project plans, dependency mapping, executive business reviews, escalation paths, and the operating cadence that keeps multi-site deployments on schedule.
* **Measurable Customer Outcomes:** Own the metrics that matter, such as time-to-live for new deployments, utilization, and expansion revenue, and be accountable for moving them.
* **New Verticals & Products:** Stand up the go-to-market and operating playbook for new segments and product lines where one doesn’t exist yet, then systematize it so the next launch is faster.
* **Data-Driven Problem Solving:** Root-cause customer issues through hands-on analysis, build the reporting that surfaces where programs break, and turn findings into recommendations and workflow redesigns.
* **Voice of the Customer:** Lead deep-dive discovery on complex customer workflows and partner with Product, Engineering, and Clinical to turn what you learn into scalable product solutions.
* **Deal-to-Delivery Handoff:** Plug into late-stage deals to scope programs correctly, then own the conversion of contracted revenue into live, healthy deployments.
* **Trusted Partnership:** Act as a strategic advisor to key customer stakeholders, partnering with Support to create clear documentation and guidance that helps top-tier customers navigate complex workflows with confidence.
* **Build the Playbook:** Document what works, including implementation templates, escalation frameworks, and account operating models, so the function scales beyond you.

**What You’ll Bring**

* **Experience:** 2–6+ years in Strategy & Operations at a high-growth startup, management consulting, banking, or program management.
* **Ownership & Track Record:** A demonstrated history of owning and driving key business outcomes on high-performing teams. You’ve carried a number, a launch, or a portfolio.
* **Analytical Rigor:** Comfort digging into raw data to root-cause problems and defending recommendations with evidence. SQL or advanced spreadsheet fluency preferred.
* **Systems Thinking:** An instinct for mapping dependencies and understanding how early configuration choices shape long-term customer success.
* **Structured Program Management:** The ability to run complex, multi-stakeholder deployments that go beyond the scope of a typical CSM.
* **Startup Fit:** You roll up your sleeves, believe done is better than perfect, know which corners are safe to cut, and operate with urgency and accountability.
* **Excellent Communication:** A clear, concise communicator who makes complicated things simple, in person and in writing, up to the C-suite.
* **Curiosity:** Genuinely curious about customers, the product, and the autism care space, with a habit of asking questions and seeking better ways to work.

* Experience in healthcare technology, post-acute care, or healthcare financial services.

* A fast-paced environment full of substantive challenges.
* Competitive salary and equity.

Revin builds AI-powered software for the businesses that keep our homes running: roofing, HVAC, plumbing, remodeling, and more. We help these businesses respond to customers, book appointments, and manage the customer experience across voice, SMS, and email.

**What You Will Do**

* Own every onboarding end to end, from signed contract to launch, as the primary point of contact for coordinating getting each customer live on time.

* Make sure every Account Executive handoff document is complete before kickoff, and draft and execute the onboarding plan.
* Run phone number setup for each customer: manage registrations and approvals from end to end to set up the infrastructure needed to deliver our product.
* Set each new customer up in Revin's internal systems, including contract details, account records, and the onboarding tracking.
* Work with FDEs and Customer Success managers to ensure they have the information they need to successfully hold onboarding meetings and launch new customer workflows.
* Track every onboarding against its timeline and flag delays and blockers to the team early.
* As the resident onboarding expert, build on our existing systems and playbooks to turn onboarding into a scalable machine and improve it with each customer so launches get faster.

**What to Expect in the Role**
------------------------------

* You will run many onboardings at once, each with its own customer, FDE, and deadlines.
* The work is detailed and regulated. Carrier registration has strict rules, and compliance can make or break onboarding timelines and the customer experience.
* You will work with multi-location home services businesses, from family-owned operators to private equity-backed rollups. Prior home services experience is not required.
* Our onboarding process is being codified as we grow, and you will help write it.
* Work at a startup is fast-paced and business needs evolve. High performers can have the opportunity to work on adjacent projects across the business and grow with the company.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 1+ years of experience in implementation, onboarding, project management, or operations, ideally at a fast-growing B2B SaaS, AI, or tech company.
* A project management fanatic. Organized, process-oriented, and maniacal about follow-through. Every task has an owner and a date, and you chase loose ends until they close.
* Someone who cares about customers and wants them to feel taken care of from the first day.
* Comfortable with technical, rules-heavy processes. This is the nature of operating in a regulated industry and attention to detail is paramount.
* A clear writer and communicator who can explain a delay to a customer and keep a team aligned.
* A quick learner who picks up new tools fast and is comfortable using AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT in daily work.
* Excited to work in a rapidly growing startup environment surrounded by people that raise the bar every day.
* Bonus: prior startup experience or time in a highly unstructured environment.

**This Role May Not Be the Right Fit If**
-----------------------------------------

* You need a fully mature operating environment with a predefined answer for every situation.
* You do not have practice owning detailed execution. This role owns the details.
* You are uncomfortable juggling many deadlines and moving pieces at once.
* You want a safe, predictable 9-5. This role is not expected to routinely work nights and weekends, but occasional after-hours work is part of delivering excellent customer service.

**Compensation and Benefits**
-----------------------------

* $90,000- 110,000 base salary
* Meaningful early equity in the company you're helping build
* Excellent health coverage. $0 employee premiums for individual medical coverage on most plans, plus dental and vision insurance
* 401(k) matching up to 4% of salary. Contribute 5% to receive the full match
* Unlimited PTO
* Commuter benefits
* Free lunches and dinners in the office

**If You’re the Best at Sales, You Have a Place with the** **Best in Pests**

As part of the Orkin Commercial sales team, you get the advantage of a highly persuasive pitch: top-notch service from an iconic brand name and the industry leader with almost 125 years of protecting homes and businesses. That’s backed by award-winning training that ensures the professionalism and expertise of all Orkin Pros and the Orkin Guarantee that demonstrates our commitment to customer satisfaction.

This role combines your competitive drive and your desire to be part of a talented team. You’ll have the opportunity to maximize your financial potential with high-performance sales skills and contribute to the overall success of the business. And you can earn your way to an annual rewards trip honoring top performers, not to mention chart a path to leadership opportunities.

You’ll have **more than a job**—you’ll have a **career with growth potential and benefits** that go beyond the basics. This includes a company vehicle, competitive pay and a 401(k) program. Not to mention, you’ll receive **opportunities to volunteer and give back** so that everyone has a safe place to live, work, and play. Work alongside a team that values safety, professionalism, empathy, integrity and innovation in pursuit of our mission to deliver the peace of mind only an Orkin Pro can provide.

With Orkin’s award-winning training program, you’ll **receive all the tools you need to succeed**. That means no industry experience required to start building your career. Plus, if there’s one thing we know at Orkin, it’s that pests keep coming back, and that makes our industry recession resistant.

**Ready to start a career with staying power?** **Apply now!**

  
Responsibilities:

As an **Outside Sales Rep**, you’ll be responsible for understanding Orkin’s products and services and how to sell them to a variety of industries. You’ll make strategic recommendations to new and existing customers to help prevent pests, uphold quality and safety, and satisfy their regulatory standards. You’ll solve problems and build trusted relationships as an essential partner protecting their business. Adept at listening to needs and clearly explaining practical solutions, you can win over customers with confidence and care.

**You will…**

* Prioritize **safety** in all responsibilities
* Conduct yourself with the utmost **professionalism** and **integrity** with customers and coworkers.
* Serve as an **empathetic** problem solver for commercial customers by utilizing the in-depth training provided to recommend the best **innovative** overall solution for each customer's needs.
* Achieve sales goals through prospecting new business and assigned leads.
* Utilizing marketing tools to drive new business development.
* Conduct an inspection of the interior and exterior of the customer’s commercial property—don’t worry, we teach you how!
* Make recommendations to customers based on your inspection and issues identified by addressing any questions, explaining the solution, and setting expectations so they have peace of mind about their pest program.
* Use the iPad we provide to prepare sales agreements and help you stay organized—we will provide training on this too!

**We Offer…**

* **Estimated first-year earnings: $****60,000 to $100,000** **USD annually**
* **Base plus uncapped commission**
* **Company vehicle with gas card after training is completed**
* Company provided iPhone and iPad with sales software
* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, maternity, & life Insurance
* 401(k) plan with company match, employee stock purchase plan
* Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave
* Employee discounts, tuition reimbursement, dependent scholarship awards
* Industry leading, quality, comprehensive training program

**Why Orkin?**

* You’re seeking an opportunity with career potential in a reliable, recession-resistant industry
* You have a service-oriented mindset that leads you to build loyalty and trust with customers
* You hold yourself responsible to commitments
* You value being part of a team
* You want to keep learning, improving and developing as a leader
* You want to join a company that supports the community
* **You want a career with a purpose at a mission-driven company that values**
  + *Safety*
  + *Professionalism*
  + *Empathy*
  + *Integrity*
  + *Innovation*

Qualifications:

**Minimum Requirements:**

* **No Experience Required!! Sales experience preferred**
* High School Diploma or equivalent required
* Valid driver’s license required
* Ability to obtain the appropriate pesticide license/certification if required (company paid)
* Ability to work in the field independently and interact with our great clients

**Physical Demands / Working Conditions:**

Candidates must meet physical job requirements and safely perform the job duties with or without accommodations:

* Safely use a ladder within the manufacturer's weight capacity
* Occasionally lift and carry up to 50 lbs.
* Safely access crawl spaces, attics, confined spaces, roof tops, etc. including the ability to climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl
* Wear personal protective equipment (PPE) which sometimes requires an OSHA-compliant respirator
* Willing to work in different types of weather conditions

*Orkin is an Equal Opportunity/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities Employer*

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
### **About World 50 Group**

World 50 Group is a global leader in facilitating meaningful collaboration among C-suite executives from the world’s most influential companies. Through curated peer communities, strategic insights, and trusted exchange, we empower senior leaders to navigate challenges, share experiences and create lasting impact. We cultivate community, where leaders go beyond their company, to co-create a future of extraordinary impact.

### **Job Description**

**Role:** Business Development Representative(known internally as Membership Development Associate)

**Reports To:** Carrie Brady

**Location:** Atlanta

**Workplace Type:** We ask all employees to work a hybrid schedule, with a minimum 3x/week in their local office. We welcome employees to utilize office space more than that where possible.

If you’re a commercially minded, experienced sales professional looking to leverage your expertise and be part of a supportive, high-performing team, this is an exceptional opportunity.

As a BDR on our Membership Development team at World 50 Group, you will play a crucial role in bringing new business into our communities. You will be our eyes and ears in the market, confidently pitching the World 50 communities and building relationships with senior executives in multi-billion-dollar organizations.

#### **The Role**

On a day-to-day basis, you will go beyond standard lead generation to act as a strategic partner in the sales process. You will be responsible for executing thoughtful, highly customized outreach to C-suite prospects, relentlessly building and managing a sales pipeline, and educating prospects on the value World 50 Group delivers. You will ruthlessly prioritize your day, focusing on the activities closest to revenue, while executing sales development best practices with maturity and exceptional poise. If you possess deep business acumen, a competitive spirit, radical ownership over your outcomes, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, this role is perfect for you.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Strategic Outreach & Prospect Experience:** Execute critical and thoughtful outreach (including cold calling) to C-suite executives via telephone, email, and LinkedIn. Care deeply about the prospect experience, balancing high quality with strong conversion metrics (e.g., aiming for benchmarks like a 5% outreach-to-call and 10% outreach-to-close ratio).
* **Radical Pipeline Ownership:** Take daily, proactive, and emotional ownership of your pipeline post-Call 1. Care deeply for the outcome regardless of whether you’re the one getting it over the line. Know your opportunities inside and out, and push things forward independently rather than waiting for instructions to progress deals.
* **Ruthless Prioritization:** Manage multiple priorities thoughtfully by focusing on what is "closest to the money" (e.g., responding to warm email replies immediately) while maintaining impeccable, real-time administrative updates in our CRM.
* **Internal Collaboration & Execution:** Partner seamlessly with Group Leaders and Sales Directors by maintaining a continuous feedback loop. Be proactive in bringing all the right people into the conversation early, strategize effectively and independantly execute on the agreed-upon next steps. This communication is one of our earliest indicators of success.
* **Market Intelligence:** Discover new accounts and contacts that are strong fit for the World 50 Group value proposition, continuously ensuring data accuracy within our CRM.

##### **Key Requirements**

* Experienced: 3-5 years of proven experience in cold-calling, complex B2B sales, business development, or a similar environment. *(Note: Prior experience selling to the C-suite is a great bonus, but we can teach this to candidates with the right foundation!)*
* Competitive & Resilient: A strategic ‘hunter’ with a relentless hustle, deep resilience, and a competitive drive to close.
* Mature Executive Presence: You possess the maturity, poise, gravitas, and business acumen necessary to carry yourself confidently when interacting with both global executives and senior internal stakeholders.
* Adaptable Problem Solver: You aren't rigid to processes. You analyze situations critically, pivot when necessary, connect the dots, and articulate complex concepts in compelling language.
* Proactive Collaborator: Exceptional communication skills with a proven track record of effectively looping in and collaborating with senior sales leaders.
* Continuous Learner: Passionate about personal development and growth.

#### **Why World 50 Group?**

The **World 50 Group Way** is our unified cultural framework that defines who we are and how we operate, shaped by insights and input from our associates. It brings together our mission, purpose, values, and DNA to foster a culture of community, collaboration, learning, and lasting impact.

**Our DNA -** How we show up

* **Member Obsessed:** Building real connections and helping our members win is what drives us.
* **Entrepreneurial:** We see challenges as chances to get creative and make things happen.
* **Collaborators:** We’re stronger together: we share ideas, support each other, and create amazing experiences as one team.
* **Learners:** We stay curious, keep growing, and never stop learning.
* **Humble:** We aim high but leave our egos at the door - it’s about progress, not perfection.
* **Community:** We celebrate wins, hold each other accountable, and have plenty of laughs along the way.

As a purpose driven company, we’re dedicated to building a workplace where people from different backgrounds can do their best work. Our company value *One & All*, demonstrates our commitment to creating a place where every individual feels seen, supported, and free to bring their whole selves to work. When people feel genuinely valued and included, they’re more engaged and effective. That’s why we focus on cultivating an environment that celebrates difference, empowers

CBRE is the world's largest commercial real estate services firm. We treat the daily experience of work as a product worth obsessing over, and we build our teams with people who feel the same way.

**About The Role:**

As a CBRE Meeting and Events Coordinator, you will assist with the detailing and operation of meetings, conferences, and events. This job is part of the Events job function.

This role is onsite in Chicago, IL USA.

**What You'll Do:**

* Detail meetings and events with clients – floor plans, timelines, vendors, AV needs, etc. – for a small conference center and an outdoor event space. Events range from corporate meetings to outdoor weddings.
* Support day-of event operations, including gathering supplies, coordinating equipment needs, and responding to onsite requests.
* Act as the on-site contact for meetings and events, delivering a hospitable, world-class experience for attendees, event owners, and vendors.
* Cover event space sales when Manager is on PTO/leave.
* Assist with post-event reporting and reconciliation. Raise potential issues and concerns as appropriate.

* Planning ahead – being prepared for the expected and unexpected.
